name: Network Tools
description: Connection check, DNS lookup, port test, TCP ping, web page check.

changelog.1.0.1: Now says what it can do (permissions: shown before you install, enforced while it runs), is listed in the new categories, and handles Ctrl+C and command-line arguments cleanly.
changelog.1.1.0: New: DNS record viewer (A, AAAA, MX, TXT, NS, CNAME), path/hop timing, saved hosts with a watchlist and an uptime monitor that notifies you when a host goes down or comes back.
